# Stillmind powder and Neurostatic
## The three knots Trail healers tie a hide packet with three knots, one each for flower, root, and fruit. Their saying goes, “When the wind calls your name, count the knots before you answer.”
## Crafting stillmind powder Open [bold]G → Medical[/bold] with [bold]Intelligence 8[/bold] or higher. One broc flower, one Xander root, and one wild prickly pear fruit make one packet. Swallow the whole dose.
## What to expect Both remedies clear hallucinations, including phantom enemies, phantom injuries, imagined voices and weather, and rainbow vision. They also clear drunken vision, slurred speech, and chemical haze. A continuing condition such as Unstable can cause another episode after protection wears off.
Both flush other active chemicals from the bloodstream, including helpful medicine such as Stimpaks and RadAway. They spare each other. While a remedy is being metabolized, another dose of a different chem can also be flushed.
The field powder gives shorter protection. Swallowing a packet makes the patient vomit [bold]three times[/bold], about three seconds apart. The bouts empty the stomach and cost hunger and thirst. Both remedies survive the purge.
Neurostatic is the longer-acting clinical alternative. It clears the same symptoms without triggering the three bouts.
